name: Noor Ouarzazate solar complex, Morocco (MASEN)
description: about 510 MW of concentrated solar power (plus a 72 MW PV plant) across Noor I-III, including the Noor III molten-salt tower; about USD 2.5 bn; phases 2014-2018; world's largest CSP complex

sources.note: World Bank, Noor-Ouarzazate Concentrated Solar Power Project document; 510 MW CSP figure per large.stanford.edu course page, 2 Feb 2023 (citing project data); read 2026-10-28
